pre.comments: set up some constants for use during common to all task sets

post.comments: clean up any temporary files or folders

applicationBackup.comments: put application files into an archive and create the required metadata

applicationInstall.comments: installs application from an archive and create the required metadata

applicationInstallQuick.comments: installs application quickly by extracting directly to the install location bypassing some safety checks and update the required metadata

applicationPackage.comments: package the application files into an archive and create the required metadata

applicationRestore.comments: restore application from an archive and create the required metadata

systemDatabaseBackup.comments: put the system databases into an archive and create the required metadata

systemDatabaseExport.comments: export the system databases so that changes can be tracked in SVN.

tasks.message: Don't forget to check in the database folder when you check in the updates folder.

systemDatabaseImport.comments: imports data into the system databases

systemDatabasePackageDev.comments: package the system databases into an archive and create the required metadata, leaves test data in the database.

systemDatabasePackageProd.comments: package the system databases into an archive and create the required metadata, removes test data from the database

systemDatabasePrepare.comments: prepares the system databases from an archive and prepares the required metadata

systemDatabasePurgeClientData.comments: deletes all non-Default clients (batch, default, public, system as well as the systemowner client) within the database

systemDatabasePurgeHistoryTables.comments: purges all history tables within the system databases

systemDatabasePurgeTempTables.comments: purges all temporary tables within the system databases

systemDatabaseRestore.comments: restore the system databases from an archive and create the required metadata

systemRepositoryBackup.comments: put the system document repository into an archive and create the required metadata

tasks.description: System Document Repository Backup as at %TODAY%.

systemRepositoryInstall.comments: installs the system document repository from an archive and create the required metadata

systemRepositoryPackage.comments: package the system document repository into an archive and create the required metadata

systemRepositoryRestore.comments: restores the system document repository from an archive and create the required metadata
